name: guardrails
description: Blocks shell commands you pick in /config: Cloudflare cf writes, attribution lines in commits and PRs, claude/ branch names. All rules start off

cfWrites.title: Block cf deploy, migrate, init
cfWrites.description: Refuse Cloudflare's cf CLI write commands, so deploys and migrations stay in your own hands.

attribution.title: Block attribution lines
attribution.description: Refuse git commit, gh pr and gh issue commands that carry a Co-Authored-By or "Generated with Claude" line. Claude retries without it.

claudeBranches.title: Block claude/ branch names
claudeBranches.description: Refuse creating or pushing a branch named claude/…. Claude retries with a purpose prefix such as fix/ or chore/.
